item.text: I’ll take a look at the existing project and then build the reading tracker to fit its structure.

The workspace is a blank Node project, so I’m making this a lightweight server-rendered shell with a small JSON API and a file-backed store. The main screen will start with a clear empty state, and each book will have a stable shareable URL.

The core screens and file persistence are in place: adding a book writes its details and notes to `data/books.json`, finishing it moves it to the completed shelf, and each detail page has a share action. I’m doing a final pass over the project files now.

item.text:
Built Folio, a small reading journal with shelves for books you’re reading and books you’ve finished. You can add a title, author, and notes, mark a book finished, and open or share its individual book page.

Run it with `npm start` and open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). Books persist in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json); there are no accounts or database.

The app is in [server.js](/workspace/server.js), with its interface in [public/index.html](/workspace/public/index.html), [public/app.js](/workspace/public/app.js), and [public/app.css](/workspace/public/app.css).
